lastCommit.message:
OTA-1864 — the bench leaves a trail

Diagnostic coverage only. This does NOT fix Crafting Freeze 2, and no
crafting freeze cause is proven.

THE BLIND SPOT, PROVEN BY THE DEVICE RATHER THAN SUSPECTED. On 2026-09-21
the Crucible guard came up over `craft Mudstone` at 21:34:03.760 and was
never answered. JS stayed demonstrably alive to 21:34:21.255 — a cognitive
op at +3.5s, an appstate transition at +16.5s, the immediate breadcrumb at
+17.5s — and the owner force-closed. The event could not be classified
because CraftingScreen.tsx and CrucibleGuardModal.tsx emitted NOTHING: no
touch path, no press-in, no handler stages, no presentation edges, no ui
tap. Sixty-seven seconds of crafting before it — two crafts, six repairs,
and TWO SUCCESSFULLY ANSWERED guards on this very modal — produced ZERO
touch-path entries while the ring sat half empty (#19..#22, room to spare).
So "no touch was recorded during the freeze" meant exactly nothing.

WHAT LANDS. The shipped OTA-1813/1818 vocabulary, extended to the one
surface it never reached. No new instrument, no second architecture, no new
event kind:

  root     — CraftingScreen + the guard's scrim, capture phase, RETURN FALSE
  in       — notePressIn on each terminal answer control
  enter    — the control's own callback began
  dispatch — execution reached the store action
  done     — the SYNCHRONOUS action returned

A missing rung is the finding, and each one is a different fault with a
different repair: root absent / root-no-in / in-no-enter / enter-no-dispatch
/ dispatch-no-done. Before this they were one silence. Production interprets
none of it; the reader does.

REACT PRESENTATION LIFETIME, AND NOT ONE INCH MORE. The guard still does
`if (!prompt) return null`, so its <Modal> unmounts and — per react-native
0.81.5's Modal, which drops its modalDismissed subscription in
componentWillUnmount — nothing in JS can know when iOS finished tearing the
window down. The edges therefore say `react-mount` / `react-unmount`. The
words `dismissed` and `native` are pinned OUT of this surface by test, and
`react-unmount` is NOT proof of native dismissal. OTA-1863 is where that
distinction was learned and it is not being blurred.

BEHAVIOUR IS UNTOUCHED. Zero added lines contain presentationHandoff,
onDismiss, setTimeout, setInterval, requestAnimationFrame,
InteractionManager, async, await, Promise, pointerEvents, animationType,
visible, disabled or StyleSheet.create. No Modal prop, mounting, style,
layout, disabled-state, store semantic or synchronous ordering changes. Both
captures are capture-phase and return false, so no control loses the
responder negotiation it has today. No try/catch wraps the answer: if it
throws, `done` is simply never written — which IS the signal — and the
exception propagates exactly as before.

CraftingScreen also names itself via setTouchPathContext({ screen:
'crafting' }). Without it a crafting record inherits the last screen named,
which in the 2026-09-21 trace was `exploration` — on a life that died on
the crafting screen. `presentation` stays 'none' there because that screen
does not own the guard's visibility, so no store subscription is added and
nothing re-renders.

COVERAGE. New suite ota1864TheBenchLeavesATrail, 12 tests: both root
captures (emit, and return false), the full ladder on SAVE ALL / CANCEL /
SPEND IT ALL / SAVE TICKED, the disabled control reporting nothing rather
than a false completion, the react-mount/react-unmount pair with `dismiss`
and `native` negated, the Modal's props unchanged with onDismiss/onShow
absent, one press answering exactly once, and TWO negative controls — the
ladder assertion going red for each missing rung and for a split
interaction, then the real production hook silenced by mock so a lost
`dispatch` turns the contract red while the gameplay answer still happens.

Two harness defects were found and fixed in the test, not production:
findAllByType could not match react-native's memo+forwardRef Pressable, and
a test that threw before unmount() leaked a live store subscriber into a
later test. Trees are now tracked and torn down in afterEach.

VALIDATION on this exact tree: ota1864 12/12 · 22/22 check gates ·
typecheck:ci clean · typecheck:tests 196 at baseline, no growth · lint clean
· fast surface 1362/1362 suites, 15,622 passed / 3 skipped, exit 0.

DISPLAY_VERSION 4.32.11 and runtimeVersion 2.5.0 unchanged.

NOT CLAIMED: Crafting Freeze 2 fixed; a native input wedge proven; all
freezes fixed; event 12 explained; #174 resolved; verification against a
real recurrence. ChapterCard body-tap stays low-priority UI-contract debt.
